facts.fact: Research by the Centre for Inclusive Development, presented by Tracy Onabis Agbamu, assessed about 30 government digital platforms and found only 47 per cent met the required accessibility threshold.
facts.system: CID assessment of government digital platforms

facts.fact: NITDA said it is looking to advance national accessibility standards and that accessibility considerations are already incorporated into its revised website guidelines for government institutions.
facts.system: NITDA revised website guidelines for government institutions

systems.system: NITDA revised website guidelines for government institutions
